messages:
maya: Heads-up — putting together a small Redwood sample app that shows OTEL+Datadog trace export + Redwood request tags. Goal: 1) quickstart for customers, 2) dashboard template for Datadog, 3) an example for marketplace listing. Link to draft repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/otel-samples (draft)

kevin: love it. what's the target runtime? node/python/java?

maya: starting with Python + FastAPI because it's closest to our examples. then a Node + Express follow-up. basic spans for request->model-inference->cache

sam: cc @datadog-partner — can we get a recommended DD trace attributes list? we want to include model.name, model.version, request.latency_ms, tokens.generated

datadog-partner: happy to. we'll provide a template and a dashboard JSON. also recommend setting env tag redwood.env and service to "redwood-inference". will upload soon.

julie: FYI need to check that none of the example telemetry leaks customer prompt text. sanitization checklist: mask prompt content, hash prompt IDs, and include a toy flag in examples

maya: good catch. sample code will show anonymization: hash(prompt) and only include prompt_length. snippet:

```
hashed = hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
attrs["prompt_id"] = hashed
attrs["prompt_length"] = len(prompt)
```

kevin: for Datadog exporter, use OTLP with ddtrace or dd-agent? any preference from partner?

datadog-partner: OTLP/gRPC to agent is ok. for quickstart we can show OTLP_EXPORTER with endpoint http://localhost:4317 and a small docker-compose. will attach compose file

sam: also need a dashboard with template variables for org, deployment, model. I can wire a dashboard with templating and a share link for marketplace listing

maya: timeline: sample + README by EOW, dashboard + partner JSON next Tue, PR for docs and quickstart for marketplace by end of month. can folks volunteer for review? :eyes:

julie: I'll review the privacy/sanitization bits

kevin: I'll do runtime/server instrumentation review

sam: I'll own dashboard + compose

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created draft branch "obs/otel-sample" and ran CI — 2 tests failed (lint). logs: https://ci.redwood/435

maya: thanks — fixing lint now

datadog-partner: quick note on announcement cadence — if this is ready by EOM we can include it in our May marketplace highlight. want to sync on joint blurb next week

maya: great — putting a calendar invite for Tue 10am PT. agenda: sample walkthrough, dashboard templating, announcement blurb. thanks everyone :rocket:
